label: a_sch_office02_eve03
text: A lot of the teachers here are real colorful\ncharacters. I need to try harder to stand out.

label: a_sch_office02_ni01
text: If it’s Mr. Jacq you’re after, you should try the\nbiology lab. That’s usually where you’ll find him.

label: a_sch_office02_ni05
text: Director Clavell is an inspiration. He never talks\ndown to anyone even though he’s so important.\r\nI hope I can be a great man like him someday.
